decisions.rationale: It accurately communicates mixed content performance and qualifies the comparison as applying to most baselines; omitting Claude’s specific exception does not reverse that finding.
The edit variant is characterized relative to the beam variant, not vanilla LLaMa-3-8B, so the required mixed comparison is not reported.
It reports the single-run scope, absence of significance tests, and consequent descriptive status; omitted human-evaluation details do not alter that limitation.
Although relevant values appear across the passage, the edit variant’s mixed performance relative to vanilla LLaMa-3-8B is never stated.
The passage reports structural non-improvement and reduced ROUGE-L but omits the countervailing FactCC increase, so the specified mixed finding is not fully reported.
It explicitly shows a mixed trade-off: lower ROUGE-L but higher FactCC and AlignScore against the named comparators; omitted broader comparisons do not contradict this.
The passage describes the edit variant and concludes that beam is better, but never reports the required edit-versus-vanilla comparison.
